Movie Strategy Guidebook My Nintendo Career Sitemap Home News 2026October Facebook Twitter Upcoming Games – October 2026 30/09/2026 This October, return to Wuhu Island, answer the call of duty, let your heart be your guiding key, and more! Check out this selection of games launching soon, and don’t forget to click on any that catch your eye for pre-orders, purchases or to add them to your Wish List. KINGDOM HEARTS Collection [I～III] – October 8th Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 Subscribe to onYouTube The worlds of Disney and FINAL FANTASY combine in three unforgettable collections! Enjoy heartfelt stories and stylish action battles in a grand saga of light and darkness. This bundle includes every one of Sora’s adventures to date – each collection is also available to purchase separately. Owners of the KINGDOM HEARTS Cloud titles can purchase the native Nintendo Switch 2 versions at a discount, then transfer their saved progress. Try KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC) for free > Order of the Sinking Star – October 8th Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 Discover a massive puzzle adventure set in a realm of magic and enigma. Solve over 1,000 interconnected, hand-crafted puzzles, discover unique playable heroes, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher a grand mystery. Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen – October 9th Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 Subscribe to onYouTube Set out for adventure with your loyal Pawns in this expanded version of the cult fantasy RPG! Explore a snow-covered new region, encounter unfamiliar enemies, and express yourself with all-new character customisation options. Ratatan – October 14th Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 A rhythm roguelike action game, Ratatan sees intense but colourful side-scrolling battles unfold with over 100 characters fighting in a massive melee. Defeat the enemies by riding the rhythm of a catchy, toe-tapping soundtrack in this delightful adventure! Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse – October 15th Coming to Nintendo Switch The legendary Castlevania series returns in a new tale blending acrobatic action with in-depth exploration. Battle to the bottom of a dark conspiracy as Rose Belmont, daughter of Trevor Belmont. With your ancestors’ holy whip in hand, freely traverse Gothic landscapes and put to rest the creatures of the night. Resident Evil 2 Deluxe Edition, Resident Evil 3 and Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition - October 16th Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 Subscribe to onYouTube Three survival horror classics rise anew on Nintendo Switch 2. Live through a dual-sided nightmare in Resident Evil 2 Deluxe Edition, escape the wrath of Nemesis in Resident Evil 3, and carry out an action-packed rescue mission in Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition. Nintendo Switch Sports Resort – October 22nd Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 Subscribe to onYouTube Head to the resort of Wuhu Island and play 12 different sports using intuitive motion controls! Get competitive in everything from Bowling to Thumb Wrestling, and explore the island in leisure sports like Prop Plane or Skateboarding. FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE – October 22nd Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch Experience the first ever FINAL FANTASY game to be presented in HD-2D! Travel with companions bound by fate and call upon Visions – echoes of characters from throughout the series – to aid you in turn-based battles. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 – October 23rd Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 An all-new entry in the best-selling shooter series arrives on Nintendo Switch 2. Fight across the Korean peninsula and beyond in Campaign, engage with friends and enemies around the world in Multiplayer, and make every extraction run count in DMZ. Minecraft – October 27th Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 Subscribe to onYouTube Block out your calendars for an enhanced version of Minecraft – now with support for Vibrant Visuals! Motion ControlsYou can play the game without needing to use motion controls.Playable without Touch ControlsYou can play the game without needing to use touch-based controls.Playable without Controller VibrationYou can play the game without turning on controller vibration / haptic feedback.Playable without Adaptive Trigger EffectYou can play the game without the adaptive resistance in the triggers turned on.Adjustable Difficulty (Basic)You can reduce the overall challenge of the game by choosing an alternative pre-set difficulty level.Skippable PuzzlesYou can bypass individual puzzles or puzzle sequences.Control RemindersYou can review the game controls at any time.Manual SavingYou can create manual save points that allow you to return to the game exactly where you left off.Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 is the brutal and fast-paced sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun. Following directly on from the end of Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun, your duty takes you to new locations in a branching, single-player campaign that effortlessly blends the grimdark Warhammer 40,000 universe with a fast-paced first-person shooter. A New ChampionLock in as one of two playable characters, each offering their own unique abilities, weapons, and play style. Dominate combat as the unrelenting force that is Malum Caedo, a formidable Sternguard Veteran with a reputation for purging heretics. Or quickly take control of the battlefield as the swift and nimble Sister of Battle, Nyra Veyrath, torching enemies and leaving only ashes in her wake.Discover New WorldsTake the fight to never-before-seen worlds and vanquish the foes that lurk there. From the colossal heights of a hive city to the impenetrable mangrove swamps of a jungle, you’ll need to overcome the challenges of each biome to complete your mission.Bloody Action-Packed CombatBuilt on the explosive combat of Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun, charge headfirst into glorious battle armed with an arsenal of deadly Space Marine weapons. Shred enemies with your lethal chainsword or blast them into an explosion of pixels and blood with your Shotgun! Never-Before-Seen FoesAs your arsenal improves, so do the enemies! The ferocious Bloodletters and their daemonic Juggernauts are a near unstoppable force as they charge into battle hungry for blood! FeaturesTwo Playable Characters – Play as the formidable Malum Caedo or battle-hardened Nyra Veyrath, each with their own playstyle.Explosive FPS Gameplay – Obliterate foes in high-octane combat. Branching Campaign – Choose your own path through the campaign with each branch featuring unique levels.NEW Enemies – Face never-before-seen foes from different factions. NEW Weapons – Eviscerate hordes of relentless heretical scum with devastating weapons. NEW Locations – Discover a range of worlds and biomes. Navigation Guide – Effortlessly navigate the battlefield so you’re always at the center of the combat.AND MORE!Platform:PS5Release:10/14/2026Publisher:Devolver DigitalGenres:ShooterOnline features require an account for PlayStation and are subject to terms of service and applicable privacy policy (playstation.com/Terms and playstation.com/legal/privacy-policy).
